## Security Vulnerability Report

### Summary

Multiple CVEs have been identified in the Temporal Admin Tools Docker image affecting MySQL version 8.0.43-1.el9_6. This is a vendor-dependent base image issue that requires upstream resolution from the Temporal project.

**Affected Image:**
- `temporalio/admin-tools:1.27.2`
- MySQL Version: `8.0.43-1.el9_6`

### CVE Details

| CVE ID | Component | Severity | CVSS Score | Description |
|--------|-----------|----------|------------|-------------|
| [CVE-2023-6129](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-6129) | MySQL | HIGH | TBD | MySQL vulnerability |
| [CVE-2024-21000](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-21000) | MySQL | HIGH | TBD | MySQL vulnerability |
| [CVE-2026-21936](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-21936) | MySQL | HIGH | TBD | MySQL vulnerability |
| [CVE-2026-22015](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-22015) | MySQL | HIGH | TBD | MySQL vulnerability |
title: [Security] Multiple CVEs in Temporal Docker Image - MySQL Dependencies
